messages.subject: upcoming talks, workshops and courses
messages.body_plain:
Hope all going well with you and enjoy the weekend.

Check out the new skin on the konfound-it app: https://konfound-project.shinyapps.io/konfound-it/

Here are some upcoming workshops and courses.  Perhaps see you at one.

Feb 14: University of Arizona. Two Key Techniques for Quantifying the Robustness of Causal Inferences <https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/p4o7z4abik4pr0nmvk7kx/Sensitivity-analysis-course-for-Statistical-horizons-short-course.docx?rlkey=0sru6xolbe1t19f4owpnxiopb&dl=0>.

Feb 29-March 1: Statistical Horizons. Two Key Techniques for Quantifying the Robustness of Causal Inferences <https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/p4o7z4abik4pr0nmvk7kx/Sensitivity-analysis-course-for-Statistical-horizons-short-course.docx?rlkey=0sru6xolbe1t19f4owpnxiopb&dl=0>. Virtual. Register here <https://statisticalhorizons.com/seminars/two-key-techniques-for-quantifying-the-robustness-of-causal-inferences/>.

April 11 (3:30 p.m.): MSU Biostats. Robustness of Inference to Replacement & Fragility for Logistic Regression and Hazard Functions <https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/010knhanm8pfaomuacw0b/modifying-data-for-cox-regression.pptx?rlkey=di9nox6hh2wr84tvan6hhoos3&dl=0>. Room E111 East Fee Hall, MSU.

April 12: (tentatively).  AERA, Philadelphia. What would it take to Change your Inference? Opening the Discourse about Causal Inferences to a Range of Stakeholders <https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/jomy6umtymtl5qqf262a6/aera-workshop-2024.docx?rlkey=m9auszimcsrpq49r4r6sjyv7o&dl=0>.

April 17: Chicago. Society for Research on Adolescence <https://www.s-r-a.org/2024-annual-meeting-portal>. What Would it take to Change an Inference? Quantifying the Robustness of Causal Inferences in Adolescent Research <https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/egt60rbuzvxm1xqcag43i/What-Would-it-take-to-Change-an-Inference-Frank-society-for-research-on-adolescence.docx?rlkey=7sqn0v3c6oldobitkazc31v9q&dl=0>. Details <https://www.s-r-a.org/2024-annual-meeting-pre-conference-program>

May 23: University of Gothenburg, Sweden. Robustness of Inference to Replacement & Fragility for Logistic Regression and Hazard Functions. Background here <https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/010knhanm8pfaomuacw0b/modifying-data-for-cox-regression.pptx?rlkey=di9nox6hh2wr84tvan6hhoos3&dl=0>.

Ken
